items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] "...Ibrahim and the Mother Hagar" -- which is a Biblical thing, you know. We are descendants of that. "And the son of Ishmael." It was on the card. [INTERVIEWEE] I remember that.

ctx.x: "...Ibrahim and the Mother Hagar" -- which is a Biblical thing, you know. We are descendants of that. "And the son of Ishmael." It was on the card.

I remember that. They'd go to Newark, and this man would straighten your head out. They was defiant with that. Like that time we walked into that hotel in Springfield. The man said "no rooms in here" when he saw us.
